sentences.text: Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Jyoti Saran
2 14-06-2012 Heard Mr. Chakrapani, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Pushkar Narain Shahi, learned A.A.G.14 for the State and its authorities.

The petitioner has questioned the order bearing memo No.29 dated 30.05.2012 issued under the signature of Commissioner, Food Safety cum Secretary, Health, Bihar, Patna in exercise of power vested under Section 92(2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Sections 26 and 30 thereof and the regulations framed thereunder, whereby the Commissioner has put a ban on the manufacturing, storage, distribution and sale of Gutkha and Panmasala containing tobacco and nicotine as ingredients, for a period of one year from the date of issuance of the notification in the entire State of Bihar.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, Sections 26 and 30
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the notification in question is in the teeth of the pronouncement of the Apex Court in a judgment since reported in (2004)7 SCC 68 as also the provisions of Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply with the Distribution) Act, 2003.

entities.text: Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply with the Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is stated that even where the regulation 2.3.4 of the regulation in question seeks to put a restraint exclusively on the sale of articles containing Tobacco and nicotine, the respondent Commissioner by the impugned notification has sought to even ban the manufacture, storage and distribution of the said articles without allowing any opportunity to the manufactures/dealers thereof to transfer/dispose of their goods to place where there is no such ban.

A prayer for stay of the impugned notification has been made inter alia on grounds that the respondents are conducting raids on the godowns of the dealers for seizing the products of Panmasala and Gutkha in purported action taken pursuant to the notification in question .

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Let a comprehensive counter affidavit be filed in response to the issues raised in the writ petition within a period of two weeks.

Considering the nature of grievance raised and the validity of the period of the notification, let the matter come up for consideration before the regular bench as per roster on 2.7.2012 within top 10 cases.
If no counter affidavit is filed by the next date fixed in the case the petitioner would be at liberty to renew his prayer for interim relief before the bench concerned.

(Jyoti Saran, J) Bibhash/-
